name: FINCHAIN
description: FINCHAIN is a symbolic benchmark for verifiable chain-of-thought financial reasoning, covering 58 topics across 12 financial domains with parameterized symbolic templates and executable Python traces. It enables machine-verifiable multi-step reasoning evaluation using the CHAINEVAL metric that assesses both final answer correctness and step-level reasoning consistency.
reputation: A new symbolic finance reasoning benchmark from a recent paper, with early-stage adoption and no established community standard yet.
notes: Enables contamination-free data generation and verifiable reasoning; exposes limitations of current LLMs in financial symbolic reasoning.
